👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Doston, India aur European Union ne ek aisa trade deal sign kiya hai jise “Mother of All Trade Deals” kaha ja raha hai. Ek taraf hai European Union, jo duniya ki second-largest economy hai, aur doosri taraf hai hamara Bharat — duniya ki fourth-largest aur fastest-growing major economy. Is deal ke baad Bharat ko 27 European countries ke market ka direct access milega, jahan hamare 99% exports par zero tax lag sakta hai. Reports yeh bhi claim kar rahi hain ki agle 5 saalon mein India ka export 100% tak badh sakta hai, aur isi wajah se global politics mein bhi is deal ko lekar kaafi halchal hai. Saath hi, sarkar ka kehna hai ki isse Make in India ko bhi zabardast boost mil sakta hai.
Lekin jahan media zyadatar is deal ke positive aspects dikha rahi hai, wahin ek important sawal ignore ho raha hai. Pehle bhi jab India ne Japan, Singapore aur Thailand ke saath Free Trade Agreements sign kiye, tab kai sectors mein fayde se zyada nuksaan dekhne ko mila, kyunki kuch loopholes aur structural challenges ki wajah se India expected benefits nahi le paaya. Isliye har FTA automatically faaydemand ho, yeh zaroori nahi hota.
Toh is episode mein hum samjhenge ki Free Trade Agreement hota kya hai, is nayi EU deal se India ko asal mein kya fayda ho sakta hai, pichle FTAs mein India ko kahaan nuksaan hua, aur sabse important — is deal ka ek aam Bharatiya par kya impact padega.
